items.title: Hackers Sell ICMacOS Remote Access Trojan for $699 a Week to Target Mac Users
items.description:
Cybercriminals are selling a Mac malware kit that can do far more than steal passwords. The tool, called ICMacOS or Icarus macOS, is offered for $699 a week on Russian-speaking dark web forums. It began as a basic data stealer, but its newer version can stay hidden on a Mac, survive restarts, and run commands […]

items.description:

Tracked as CVE-2026-111497, the flaw could let an attacker corrupt memory, expose sensitive data, crash a service, or potentially run code without authentication. items.description:
